versions.description_html:
When plant systems fail, the recovery plan has to work on the shop floor, not only in a document. In this episode of the iFAKT series, we discuss designing resilience for plant systems with Azure: recovery objectives, backup, failover and testing.
You will learn how to align IT recovery with production reality.
Who it is for: Plant IT, infrastructure and business continuity leads.
